text:
Situation: Isoflurane is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 100 units (12.3 days at 8.1 units per day), Corvale General holds 130 units (17 days at 7.7 units per day), and Corvale Lakeside holds 27 units (20 days at 1.4 units per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include isoflurane as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers 12 to 20 days across sites. No FDA shortage declaration exists. Supply continuity depends on securing additional purchase commitments now.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Mullan Pharmaceutical Inc. (not on FDA shortage list; sources from Shandong New Time Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd., last inspected VAI 2024-07-09). Requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify and order from Halocarbon Life Sciences, LLC (not on FDA shortage list). Requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to qualify and order from Piramal Critical Care Inc. (not on FDA shortage list). Requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate direct purchase from Shandong New Time Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (not on FDA shortage list). Requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No allocation changes or clinical substitutions at this time.
